## Jupyter notebooks on {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} for the Web

You can also use [{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} for the Web](/docs/remote/vscode-web.md) by going to [https://vscode.dev](https://vscode.dev) or [https://github.dev](https://github.dev) (available by typing '.' when viewing a repo on GitHub). With {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} for the Web, you have two options to connect to the following types of kernels for your notebook:

1. [Remote tunneling with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Server](#remote-tunneling-with-vs-code-server)
2. [Connect to a remote Jupyter server](#connect-to-a-remote-jupyter-server)
